name: Draft Eleven
summary:
Draft Eleven is a football auto-battler roguelite focused on squad building, strategy and long-term progression. Build an eleven-player team through a rotating transfer market, reroll or freeze offers, upgrade players through fusion, and combine leagues, nationalities and playstyles to create powerful synergies.

Between matches, players must decide whether to invest in immediate squad strength, manager progression, training or their club economy. Matches are played automatically, with player quality, positioning, team composition and active synergies influencing the outcome. Each run presents new decisions as the squad grows stronger and faces increasingly difficult opponents. The game is presented in a stylized 2D pixel-art football aesthetic.
